findings.summary: The implementation matches the approved convergence contract: unresolved review gates remain non-terminal and retryable, ambiguous failures remain handoff fail-closed, finalized cleanup normalizes terminal queue entries, and hosted-close routing reaches terminal only after targeted cleanup is complete and the local base matches its remote-tracking branch.
findings.broken_invariant: No invariant is broken; positive, negative, idempotent, and queue-recovery behavior is covered by the frozen diff and structured verification record.
